What Quesma sells

Examines how AI writes code to explain costs and find failures.

  • Quesma coding-agent analytics · Analyzes coding-agent sessions and costs. The reviewed product has an early-access waitlist.
  • Quesma Shipper · An open-source collector that saves agent-session transcripts in the user’s Amazon S3 storage.
  • CompileBench / OTelBench / BinaryAudit / BabaIsBench · These four benchmarks (shared tests for comparing model performance) cover specific engineering or puzzle tasks.
